001: Good morning, thank you for seeing me.
Good morning, please have a seat. Did you bring your resume?
Yes, here is an updated copy with my most recent experience.
Perfect, I see you worked several years in customer service.
That's right, and I would like to apply everything I learned to this position.
That sounds great, we will talk about it during the interview.
002: Could you tell me why you are interested in this company?
Of course, I admire its track record and the quality of its products.
And what do you think you can bring to the team?
I have experience in leadership and in conflict resolution.
That is a very valuable quality for the position we are offering.
I'm glad to hear that, I can't wait to prove it.
003: What do you consider to be your greatest professional strength?
I would say my ability to adapt to changes quickly.
And could you give me a concrete example of that adaptation?
In my previous job, I took on new tasks with very little prior training.
That shows initiative and a good attitude, no doubt.
Thank you, I always try to learn from every situation.
004: What do you think about working under pressure?
I think it's something common, and I know how to stay calm in those moments.
How do you manage stress during a tough day?
I usually organize my tasks by priority and take short breaks.
That is a very sensible strategy, I like it.
Yes, it works quite well for me.
005: Do you prefer working in a team or independently?
I like both, but I especially enjoy collaborating with others.
Because better ideas come up and you learn a lot from your coworkers.
I see, collaboration is key in our department.
That sounds great, that way I can contribute and learn at the same time.
006: Do you have any questions about the duties of the position?
Yes, I would like to know how the team is currently organized.
We work by projects and each person has a very defined role.
And how are tasks divided when there is a heavy workload?
We usually prioritize together and split the tasks fairly.
That seems like a very efficient way of working to me.
007: What is your salary expectation for this position?
I am open to negotiating, but I had a rough range in mind.
Please, tell me what range you have in mind.
Something around thirty-five thousand euros gross per year.
I'll make a note of that, we will take it into account in the process.
Perfect, thank you very much for your transparency.
008: When could you start the job if you were selected?
I would need to give two weeks' notice at my current job.
Understood, that seems like a reasonable timeframe to us.
Also, I could start earlier if necessary.
We appreciate that flexibility, we will keep it in mind.
I am very motivated to start as soon as possible.
009: Have you had any experience leading a project?
Yes, I coordinated a team of five people for two years.
What was the most difficult part of that experience?
Managing the different work paces of each team member.
That is a common challenge, and knowing how to handle it says a lot about you.
Thank you, I learned quite a bit from that stage.
010: Why did you leave your previous job?
I was looking for a new professional challenge and more opportunities for growth.
And what do you think of your previous company?
I have good memories of it, but I needed a change of scenery.
It's clear you speak sincerely, and that is important.
For me, honesty is essential at work.
